We need to answer question: "What exact date does my next invoice get generated? I need to plan around replacing my card."

We have policy excerpts. The question is about when invoices are generated, specifically the next invoice date. We have relevant policy: part 2 of 3: "That date is shown in Settings → Billing → Plan next to 'Next invoice', and it does not shift month to month even though months have different lengths; a billing date of the 31st bills on the last day of a shorter month." Also part 1: "A monthly plan is invoiced on the same day of the month as the workspace's original billing date — the date the subscription started or last renewed." Also part 3: "Because the card charge happens on that date, replacing a card a day or two beforehand is enough for the new card to be used for the upcoming invoice."

Thus answer: The next invoice will be generated on the same day of month as your original billing date; you can view the exact date in Settings → Billing → Plan next to "Next invoice". Replacing card a day or two before that date will work.
